name: dopemux-route-ledger
description: Route ledger for Claude Code: records the model each Agent call requests (warning when none is pinned) and the model and advisor server-tool-uses each model step reports, as JSONL receipts a supervisor can merge into an ExecutionBinding. Read-only: it never rewrites, denies or retries a call.

receiptDir.title: Receipt directory
receiptDir.description: Where receipt files (<sessionId>.jsonl) are written. The default is used only when .control-tower/state exists; an explicit directory is created on first write. A path containing a .. segment disables receipts.

unpinnedAgent.title: Unpinned Agent calls
unpinnedAgent.description: warn: toast once for each Agent call with no model pinned (forks excepted). off: record only.

childAdvisorBudget.title: Advisor calls allowed per child agent
childAdvisorBudget.description: Whole number. 0 (default) means a child's first advisor call exceeds the budget; a negative number disables the check.

sessionAdvisorBudget.title: Advisor calls allowed per session
sessionAdvisorBudget.description: Whole number. -1 (default) turns the session budget off.

maxReceiptsPerFile.title: Receipts per file
maxReceiptsPerFile.description: Whole number from 50 to 5000 (default 500); a new <sessionId>.<n>.jsonl segment starts after this many.
